title: Light Thai Rigatoni Pasta
description: A winey, molten Thai dish featuring rigatoni, diabetic-friendly and featuring a spicy kick from fermented kimchi.

ingredients.name: Ginger
ingredients.notes: grate or mince fresh ginger root

ingredients.name: Thai red chili peppers
ingredients.notes: or to taste, adjust for desired heat level

instructions: Bring a large pot of salted water to a boil and cook the rigatoni pasta for 8 minutes, or until al dente.
Drain the pasta and set aside to prevent sticking together.
In a large skillet or wok, heat the fermented kimchi and cook over medium-high heat for 3-4 minutes, breaking apart with a spoon if it forms clumps.
Add the light coconut milk, fish sauce, soy sauce, grated ginger, sugar, Thai red chili peppers, and salt to the skillet and stir to combine.
Bring the mixture to a simmer and cook for 2-3 minutes, or until slightly thickened.
Add the cooked rigatoni pasta to the skillet and toss to combine with the sauce, ensuring the pasta is well coated.
Add the water to the skillet and stir to combine, creating a molten sauce.
Cook for an additional 2-3 minutes, or until the sauce has thickened to your liking and the pasta is heated through.
Garnish with thinly sliced scallions and serve hot.
Taste and adjust the seasoning as needed.
Serve immediately, garnished with additional scallions if desired.
